note: Coverage exemptions for the Channel 0.2 verification gates. `build/verify-channel-0.2-coverage.ps1` runs each gate under a line trace and requires every conditional in it to be evaluated by a passing run; an entry here declares one construct that a passing run correctly cannot reach, with the reason. Two classes are exempt structurally rather than by entry, in the gate itself: anything inside a `catch`, and the `foreach ($failure in $failures)` loop each gate prints its findings with. Those are expressed as a walk to the root and as the collection the loop walks, not as lists of the ones that exist today, because AN2 was a list that held eight of nine.

authority.note: An exemption is a claim that a construct cannot be reached by a passing run. It is not a way to quiet the measure: an entry whose construct is reached fails, and an entry whose construct no longer occurs fails as stale, on the same rule the probe corpus applies to a rotted anchor. A check that is unreachable because no input exercises it is a missing input and belongs in the vector corpus, not here -- which is AR1, and is why this file has no entry for the two property clauses that had no input.

The guard is dormant because the residual work it counts is finished, which is not the same as expired: it fires again the moment the claim reappears.
